plan.title: Heart tissue treated vs control DE + pathway enrichment
plan.analytical_narrative: The dataset is bulk RNA-seq (salmon gene-level counts, 12000 genes x 12 samples) from human heart tissue, 6 treated vs 6 control, unpaired, single batch, rRNA-depleted total RNA without UMIs. Two caveats from the profile drive the plan: sample_01 has a library size ~4x below the median, and most libraries show >60% duplication. Per the grounded procedure (DESeq2/apeglm/fgsea), neither caveat is grounds for silent sample removal or de-duplication: duplication in RNA-seq without UMIs tracks expression level, so removing 'duplicates' would delete true signal, and a low-depth sample is down-weighted by its DESeq2 size factor rather than dropped by default. Step 1 performs sample-structure QC (blind VST, PCA, sample-distance heatmap, library size/duplication reporting) to inspect sample_01 and the duplication pattern before any test runs, and a decision to exclude sample_01 is made there only with a stated, data-driven reason (e.g., it is a multivariate outlier on PCA/distance, not merely low-depth). Step 2 runs the core DE workflow: minimal pre-filter (>=10 counts in >=6 samples, the smaller group size), DESeq2 median-of-ratios normalization, an explicit ~condition design with an explicit reference level (control), a Wald test, apeglm shrinkage of the log2 fold changes, and Benjamini-Hochberg adjustment with independent filtering at alpha=0.05 — reporting both the p-value histogram diagnostic and count-outlier NA flags. Step 3 runs edgeR quasi-likelihood F-test on the same filtered counts and design as a robustness cross-check, per the consensus rule that DESeq2 and edgeR should agree on most genes at this replicate depth (n=6/group); the intersection is the high-confidence gene set. Step 4 takes the full ranked gene list (Wald statistic) into fgsea preranked GSEA against MSigDB Hallmark (primary) and Reactome, WikiPathways, and GO-BP (follow-up, all staged for human) with a 15-500 gene set size window and redundancy collapsing. Step 5 assembles the final report: DE gene tables (shrunken and unshrunken log2FC, adjusted p-values), fit diagnostics (MA plot, dispersion plot), the DESeq2-edgeR overlap, enrichment tables with leading-edge genes per collection, and a full reproducibility record (session info, package versions, gene set collection versions, random seeds).

Keep genes with >=10 counts in >= smallest group size (6)
fgsea preranked on Wald statistic, MSigDB Hallmark then Reactome/WikiPathways/GO
DE + enrichment report with diagnostics, session info, reproducibility record
